**RETAIN** physiology → admitted interoception → experienced pressure. A stored
representation of physiological state may be equivalent; its storage does not grant
it authority as character knowledge. A cached value derived entirely from admitted
evidence is observationally redundant at these sampled queries. That is not proof
against additional independently acquired dynamics under a different phenomenon.
